posts.text: Nice website to visualise MTF Data — Makes you wonder how many people are actually buying it on margin because they really want to hold it, versus just waiting for the price to come back before closing the position.

posts.author: TraderJini
posts.text: Nice website to visualise MTF Data — Every time I look at the MTF exposure list and see HDFC Bank sitting right at the top, I still wonder about the people who are holding HDFC Bank on MTF At this point, the stock seems to have more committed MTF holders than committed shareholders.
